acc-1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment item icons (jewelry accessories) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing equipment sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, each item compact and filling about 60% of its cell: (1) a drop earring of crimson autumn leaves and amber beads on a dark bronze hook (RED FOREST theme), (2) a round bronze signet seal medallion engraved with a blood-red crescent moon and leaf filigree, a sacred relic of a swordswoman (RED FOREST theme), (3) a tarnished silver earring with a tiny ruined castle tower charm and violet ghost flame gem (HAUNTED RUINED CASTLE theme), (4) a cracked black-iron seal medallion with a pale violet phantom skull sigil and chains (HAUNTED RUINED CASTLE theme), (5) an icy crystal shard earring with frost-blue snowflake and silver hook (FROZEN THRONE theme). Each item is a single object (an earring is ONE single earring, not a pair). Each item clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
